seasons.spelers_ontmoeten_hun_divisiegen: Players face their division opponents once, spread across weekly rounds.
seasons.per_grens_geldt_het_kleinste_aan: At each boundary, the smaller number applies to keep divisions the same size.
seasons.niveau_1_is_de_hoogste_divisie_d: Level 1 is the highest division. The badge appears beside players when the season becomes active.
seasons.een_speler_speelt_per_seizoen_in: A player belongs to one division per season.
seasons.alleen_als_referentie_de_ladder_: For reference only. The ladder uses match points.
seasons.waarom_wordt_deze_uitslag_aangep: Why is this result being changed?
seasons.bijvoorbeeld_een_door_beide_spel: For example, a result confirmed by both players.
seasons.de_stand_wordt_opnieuw_berekend_: Standings are recalculated. A closed season becomes active again; an already assigned follow-up season locks earlier results.
seasons.indeling_vastgezet_bij_de_seizoe: Assignments fixed at the start of the season.
seasons.2_24_spelers_per_divisie_verplaa: 2–24 players per division. Move players before starting the season.
seasons.voeg_de_eerste_spelers_toe_aan_d: Add the first players to this division.
seasons.iedere_tegenstander_een_keer_de_: Each opponent once. The date is the round’s deadline.
seasons.deel_minimaal_twee_spelers_per_d: Assign at least two players per division and generate the fixtures.
seasons.3_punten_bij_winst_0_bij_verlies: 3 points for a win · 0 for a loss. DP is separate from this ladder.
seasons.volgorde_punten_legsaldo_legs_vo: Order: points → leg difference → legs won → head-to-head for two tied players. Unresolved ties share a position.
seasons.wordt_toegepast_zodra_je_het_ver: Applied when you create the follow-up season.
seasons.voorlopig_de_definitieve_indelin: Provisional. Final assignments follow after closing.
seasons.bij_deze_stand_verplaatst_er_nog: No one moves automatically at these standings yet.
seasons.maak_je_eerste_seizoen_aan_om_di: Create your first season to assign divisions and players.
